preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 3 and 100,000.
The lower limit k on the degree of the graph node must be between 2 and n - 1.
The number of edges m must be at least equal to the number of nodes n.

postconditions.description: The length of the found cycle r must be at least k + 1.
The output cycle must contain r distinct integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= v[i] <= n for i in range(r))
postconditions.description: All nodes in the cycle must be within the valid range of 1 to n.
